items.title: Santo Pecora Interview, 1972-11-09
items.q: The guys that played in that band... Tony Perrani and I was the only one that got to be known

ctx.x: He was there then. He was there then. I know his son too. Well, uh...
The guys that played in that band... Tony Perrani and I was the only one that got to be known, you know, to go out of town. Yeah.
I'm trying to think of the guys from the French Quarter then. Who was that? Johnny Lala was around? Was he with you to? Well, Johnny Lala didn't play with the Italian band, no.
